notes: PR left OPEN; one English comment; no close, no push, no change to m5stack/M5Unified.
Primary evidence is virtual-device A/B of the two behaviours the PR claims to fix, plus a sticks3 control for no regression.

Non-blocking observation 1: isEnabled() no longer checks the port, while _setup_i2c() writes I2C_NUM_MAX for a board without internal pins; today every pin table keeps SDA/SCL paired so the combination is unreachable.

Non-blocking observation 2: M5Unit OLED autodetection still requires cfg.unit_oled.i2c_port >= 0 (M5Unified.hpp:554), so a software-port Ex bus stays out of that path; pre-existing, not a regression of this PR.
The paperdiy image was built without PSRAM, so the panel was unavailable (displays=0); the I2C path under test does not depend on it.
